text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
—Tap Dance City runs and runs at the front!!
Tap Dance City!!
Can the chasers catch up!?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: (What an escape――but, not yet――)

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text: The highlight isâ

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text: It starts nooowwwwww!!!!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
—But she holds on to the lead!!
Tap Dance City!!
Tap Dance City crosses the finish line!!!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Tap Dance City, all alone on the wide Fuchu course!!
A brilliant, wire-to-wire victoryyy!!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (WOOOOOOOOH!!!!)

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Haha...!!
This is the ab-so-lute best...!!

text_block_list.name: Tap's Fan A
text_block_list.text:
Taaaap!!!
Congraaaats!!
Thank you for the greatest romance evvvver!!!

text_block_list.name: Tap's Fan B
text_block_list.text:
I was so moved~~~~~!!!
You looked incredibly cool~~~~~!!!

text_block_list.name: Tap's Fans
text_block_list.text: (Tap! Tap! Tap! Tap!)

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
"Thanks, everyone!
—It's all thanks to your support!!"

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: —Impressive as always.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
(It is precisely because someone like Tap exists—
that I can have confidence in what I must do.)

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text: —Kris S!!

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Don't you dare go deciding you've lost on your own, got it?
My race with you isn't over yet.

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
“—The final destination of the Autumn Senior Triple Crown, the Arima Kinen.
There, I'll prove once and for all that I am the true strongest.”

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: —Just what I wanted.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: Next time, I will—claim victory.

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text: Haha, you never change. But—that's what makes you great!

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text: —Now I'm getting thrilled. Let us meet again at Nakayama at year's end—

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: —Yeah.

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text: Man, that was so thrilling! Tap's rising up as a rival to Kris S! The Twinkle Series is really heating up!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
The races lately have seriously had so many legendary showdowns, it's crazy hype!!
I'm super pumped for the Arima Kinen too~!

"...I heard it.
That lovable, arrogant sound striving to sever
the chains of fate binding us—"

Do as you are guided, and indulge in all manner of tyranny!
Indeed. For the future does not belong to the world—

Symboli Kris S, having finished the fierce battle.
Though she was defeated, a faint hint of
something resembling accomplishment could be seen on her face—

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: —It felt tangible.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
In order to become an "ordeal"—
once more, facing Tap...—

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
In the final stretch of the race... her heat flared up...
all in an effort to defeat me.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
The stronger I am――
the more Tap's passion will blaze――

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: "...I have obtained... that certainty."
choice_data_list: Next, let's set the entire era ablaze!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
Yeah.
—And for that sake...

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: At the Arima Kinen... I will win. Without fail.
"To stand at the peak of this era and become the ultimate 'trial'—she begins her march toward the final showdown, the Arima Kinen...!"
